Detail: Description: Italy will vote on a referendum to reform the upper house of parliament, reducing the number of elected senators from 315 to 95. If the vote passes, it eliminates the control of the upper house over some policy areas, including its ability to oust governments by passing a motion of no confidence; | Source: Chamber of Deputies | FF Notes: The result will likely be projected before the official vote count is announced, based on early vote counts and exit polling;
